result.summary: This is a mechanical refactor that adds C++17 [[nodiscard]] to legacy functions with the pattern bool Get(...)+mutable-ref-out-param, so callers can't silently ignore a false return and use garbage output. The author fixed the handful of call sites that previously discarded the return value, in separate commits (GetOp/GetScriptOp, GetCachedLastHardenedExtPubKey). An RPC-related piece was split out into #34741, which has since merged, and this PR's remaining scope is validation (script/interpreter.cpp) and wallet (descriptor.cpp) plus other legacy getters across the codebase.
result.problem: Legacy bool+mutable-ref getters make it easy for a caller to ignore a false return and then use an unset/stale output value, a latent-bug pattern that nodiscard closes off at compile time. This affects contributors touching the affected getters more than end users directly.

result.card: This PR is a mechanical refactor that adds C++17 [[nodiscard]] to legacy bool-returning getters that also write through a mutable reference, closing off a class of bugs where a false return is silently ignored and a stale/garbage value gets used. It touches script/interpreter.cpp (GetOp/GetScriptOp, with an Assert guarding a return value the author and reviewers argue is logically guaranteed by a prior IsPushOnly check) and script/descriptor.cpp (GetCachedLastHardenedExtPubKey, now used as a cache-hit optimization). An RPC-facing piece was split out into #34741, which has already merged. Review has been broadly positive (concept ACKs from sedited and ajtowns, an approval from ryanofsky) but ryanofsky flagged the interpreter.cpp commit as 'not quite right,' leading to an unresolved side discussion about whether consensus code should depend on util/check.h. The PR is currently draft, CI is failing, and the author has been silent since a 2026-05-19 force-push with no reply to that last open thread, so it is Stale for review purposes even though nobody is blocking it.
